raw_response:
This small plot near my house has my coffee and a few fruit trees, and it has fed my family for many years. I am old now, 76, and my hands are slow, so I do what my father did — I spread the manure from my cattle around the trees and let the shade and the rains do the rest. I have no money to buy fertilizer from the cooperative for trees, and nobody in my village puts urea on coffee or fruit trees anyway. My sons and grandchildren help me weed and harvest when the time comes, so I do not need to pay anyone.
